_comment: flood_ledger_help's start: identical to flood_ledger_talk_start except heard_flood_ledger is pre-banked and flood_ledger is already in started_quests (quest events only fire for started quests, wi_game.gd:1469). The HELP route is the one thing this canonical proves, so the give beat is skipped. player_skills holds basic_cleaning ONLY -- basic_cooking is deliberately absent, so mill_flood_stack's second skill arm is unexercised here and the plain-interact SKILL_UNKNOWN + locked_toast leg is this script's own (see its _comment). Built from riverfarm_fight_start (the region's shipped baseline: post-mounting, door_awakened + riverfarm_attuned, so riverfarm_village/riverfarm_mill/witch_hollow/witch_hut all satisfy test_fixture_coherence MAP_REQUIRES). Adds blight_lifted + heard_price_of_a_favor + price_of_a_favor_reported: both v0.16 side quests hang their start option off price_of_a_favor_reported, so a save that has not closed 'The Price of a Favor' cannot see them. TRAP: rng_state is DERIVED (tests/_derive_rng_state.gd), never hand-typed; WISave restores .state directly and RNG_STATE_MIN_MAGNITUDE rejects small ints.
